title: Esrbespoke media statement
description: A full-bleed photo section on black, a window tall on phones and 140% of the window on desktop: a two-line white heading at the upper left and a short paragraph in tiny bold capitals at column 9 near the bottom. The photo fades in as it enters and drifts slower than the page.
notes: always on the dark scope (white text over the photo)
fade and parallax are CSS scroll-driven inside @supports, off under reduced motion
